adjudication.rationale: In the new `embeddable-host` component, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... })` but does not attach a `.catch(popupAjaxError)` (unlike `save()`, which does). If the DELETE request fails (e.g., network/403), the rejection is unhandled and no error is shown to the admin; additionally, `deleteHost` is only sent in the success handler, so the row remains with no feedback. This behavior is directly visible in `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`.
